name: Essex
description: Essex is a large county north-east of London, combining fertile farmland and attractive rural landscapes with rapidly growing towns and major transport corridors. Chelmsford, Colchester and Southend-on-Sea are among its principal urban centres, while the county's proximity to London strongly influences its economy.

places.name: Thurrock
places.description: A district in Essex along the Thames Estuary, home to the Lakeside shopping centre and the Dartford Crossing linking Essex to Kent.

places.name: Basildon
places.description: A New Town in Essex built from the 1940s, now one of the county's largest towns, on the Thames Estuary's northern shore.

places.name: Braintree
places.description: A rural district in Essex covering the market town of Braintree, historically known for silk weaving thanks to the Courtauld family's mills.

places.name: Brentwood
places.description: A commuter town in Essex on the edge of London's green belt, historically a coaching stop on the road from London to East Anglia.

places.name: Castle Point
places.description: A district in Essex on the Thames Estuary, covering the towns of Canvey Island and Benfleet, with a landscape shaped by 20th-century sea defences and flood history.

places.name: Chelmsford
places.description: The county town of Essex, granted city status in 2012, historically a centre for radio and electronics innovation with Marconi's early wireless work.

places.name: Colchester
places.description: Britain's oldest recorded town, founded as the Roman capital Camulodunum, with extensive Roman walls and a Norman castle built atop a Roman temple's foundations.

places.name: Epping Forest
places.description: A district in Essex named for the ancient royal hunting forest at its heart, alongside the town of Loughton on London's northeastern fringe.

places.name: Harlow
places.description: A New Town in Essex built after WWII as one of Britain's first planned 'garden cities,' known for its public sculpture collection and modernist town planning.

places.name: Maldon
places.description: A historic town in Essex on the Blackwater Estuary, known for Maldon sea salt, traditional Thames sailing barges, and the site of the 991 AD Battle of Maldon.

places.name: Rochford
places.description: A district in Essex along the Thames Estuary, covering the town of Rayleigh and Southend Airport, with marshland and countryside toward the coast.

places.name: Southend-on-Sea
places.description: A classic Essex seaside resort on the Thames Estuary, home to the world's longest pleasure pier, stretching well over a mile out to sea.

places.name: Tendring
places.description: A coastal district in Essex covering the resort town of Clacton-on-Sea and the historic 'Sunshine Coast,' including the pretty village of Manningtree.

places.name: Uttlesford
places.description: A rural district in Essex covering Stansted Airport and the historic wool town of Saffron Walden, known for its maze of medieval streets.
